title: Joe Ellibush's band and lawn party jobs on bass horn
summary: With Joe Ellibush, a poor trombonist who led the band, he played bass horn at lawn parties without piano.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh yeah, sure we had piano with us. Sure. And I remember when I played with, uh, Joe Ellibush's band. We never had no piano at that time. We used to play lawn parties. And they never had no pianos at the lawn parties. So you used to have to use the guitar or banjo.
He was a trombone player. Terrible trombone player. But he was, he went around as a trombone player anyhow.
He got the, he was the boss man. Yeah, he got the job so he was the leader.
I was playing bass fiddle. Bass horn.
